def perform(s: Session, strokes: list[dict]) -> np.ndarray:
    p = s.primitives()
    wells = s.wells()
    # Preserve the optimizer's paint order: each brush load happens between sweeps,
    # which is also how the wet colour layering in the plan was evaluated.
    tip_z_hover = 0.060
    paper_z = s.geo.z
    current_colour = None
    s.record_start()
    for i, st in enumerate(strokes, 1):
        pts = curve_points(st, s.geo)
        if current_colour != st["colour"]:
            # Every prior sweep and palette dip ends at hover height, so the fast
            # transfer stays clear of both the sheet and the neighboring wells.
            w = wells[st["colour"]]
            wx, wy = w["center_xy"]
            p["move_tip"]((wx, wy, tip_z_hover), speed=0.35, settle=3)
            p["move_tip"]((wx, wy, 0.026), speed=0.06, settle=3)
            p["move_tip"]((wx, wy, tip_z_hover), speed=0.06, settle=3)
            current_colour = st["colour"]

        start = pts[0]
        p["move_tip"]((start[0], start[1], tip_z_hover), speed=0.35, settle=2)
        p["move_tip"]((start[0], start[1], paper_z - st["press"] / 1000.0), speed=0.05, settle=3)
        for q in pts[1:]:
            p["move_tip"]((q[0], q[1], paper_z - st["press"] / 1000.0), speed=0.04,
                           settle=2 if np.allclose(q, pts[-1]) else 0)
        end, _ = s.tip_pose()
        p["move_tip"]((end[0], end[1], tip_z_hover), speed=0.06, settle=3)
        if i % 25 == 0:
            print(f"executed {i}/{len(strokes)} sweeps; contacts={len(s.strokes()) + (1 if s.pen_down() else 0)}; steps={s.n_steps}", flush=True)
    actions = s.record_stop()
    return actions
